description: Prepares a fax of a PDF to a fax number and returns a confirmation link. The fax is NOT sent and nothing is charged until the person opens the link, checks the pages and number, pays or uses their FaxUp credits, and presses Send on faxup.net. Give the PDF as file_url (public https link) or file_base64. Show the returned confirm_url to the person.

country.description: ISO country code for a number given without "+", e.g. "GB".

cover.description: Optional cover page, added ahead of the document on faxup.net.

file.description: A file the person attached in ChatGPT (filled in by the host).

file_base64.description: The PDF itself, base64-encoded (up to 25 MB).

file_url.description: Public https:// link to the PDF.

filename.description: Name shown to the person, e.g. "lease.pdf".

to_number.description: Fax number in international form, e.g. "+1 202 555 0143" or "+44 20 7123 4567". Without a "+" it is read as US/Canada, or as `country`.

name: send_fax
title: Prepare a fax (returns a link to confirm and pay)
